reapack.desc: FL Studio Keyboard Shortcut Layout Map

metadata.description: Swaps REAPER's core layout to match FL Studio's key workflow (F5 Playlist, F6 Media Explorer, F7 Piano Roll, F8 FX Browser).
A panic switch tool to safely clear out imported hotkeys and restore default keybinds.

FL Studio Workflow Environment for REAPER. Provides immediate access to FL-style key commands alongside a dedicated cleanup script. Import URL: https://github.com/MOG4125/FL-Studio-Shortcuts-For-Reaper/raw/master/index.xml
